title: Sabai Grass
descriptionHtml:
Shop handwoven Sabai grass baskets, storage boxes, planters and gift hampers from GrassCrafts. Made by Indian artisans, these natural-fibre pieces bring practical storage and thoughtful handmade style to everyday spaces.

Choose Sabai grass baskets for home organisation, shelves, laundry, gifting and festive hampers. For bulk, wedding and corporate gifting enquiries, contact GrassCrafts for available customisation options.

New to Sabai? Read what Sabai grass is, its uses and benefits or the Sabai grass buyer's guide.

title: Kauna Grass
descriptionHtml:
Handwoven Kauna Grass Products from Manipur

Discover GrassCrafts' Kauna grass collection, featuring handwoven baskets, gift hamper baskets, bags, jewellery boxes, display trays and planters made by artisans in Manipur. Kauna is a natural wetland reed traditionally woven by skilled craftspeople; its fine, tactile strands create distinctive patterns and a warm natural finish. Each handmade piece may show small variations in weave and tone.

Choose a Kauna basket for home organisation, a gift hamper for weddings and celebrations, a woven handbag for everyday use, or a jewellery box and display tray for thoughtful presentation. Explore our round Kauna gift hamper basket, square Kauna hamper basket, Kauna jewellery display tray, oval Kauna jewellery box and Kauna grass planter.

Why choose Kauna grass craft?

  • Handwoven character: visible natural fibre texture and individual artisan-made detail.
  • Lightweight and practical: useful for gifting, storage, presentation and everyday carrying.
  • Natural material: a plant-based alternative to many plastic organisers and gift containers.
  • Made by artisans: supports traditional weaving skills associated with Manipur.

For the story behind the material and its craft traditions, read our Kauna grass guide. For bulk, wedding and corporate orders, visit Wholesale & Corporate Gifting. Free shipping across India on orders above ₹1,250.
